name: Torger
title: Ironmaster of the Ore Cut
examine: Found the seam the year the fort went up, which everyone agrees is a coincidence. Pays the mountain the respect Odd pays the wood, which is why their argument never quite becomes one.
lines: The mountain pays in iron what the wood pays in years. Neither one pays twice.
A bloomery eats charcoal and charcoal is trees. Odd says so weekly. He is right, which is the annoying part.
The seam runs north under the fell. I stop where the stones say. That is the whole conversation.
